gaps.native_observed: structuredContent.data is a positional matrix (list of lists).
gaps.current_adapter_expects: top-level rows or records as a list of objects keyed by column key.
gaps.consequence: The native envelope is not projected; no business-result/v1 card is produced. A positional row cannot be represented without an explicit column-position mapping.

gaps.native_observed: columns entries expose name, label and type.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: columns entries use key, label, optional type and unit.
gaps.consequence: Even if data were converted to object rows, the current column declaration has no key and is rejected.

gaps.native_observed: rows is the page size, not the returned row count.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: rows is a list of row objects; returned_rows is computed from that list.
gaps.consequence: An integer rows value makes table_payload return no table. If it were mapped naively to total_rows it would confuse page size with matched rows.

gaps.native_observed: optional total counts output rows or groups; it is not an aggregate cell.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: total_rows only, with no total_basis or group/record distinction.
gaps.consequence: A grouped total of 3 groups cannot be represented without being misread as 3 records; grouped totals and record totals collapse into one field.

gaps.native_observed: page, has_more and page size describe finite pagination.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: no page, has_more or page-size fields; completeness is only the tool-declared complete flag.
gaps.consequence: The adapter cannot show that a page is partial, cannot distinguish a beyond-last empty page from an empty result, and cannot carry pagination state to the answer.
The result card loses which synthetic dataset produced the rows; source registration alone does not carry this native identity.

gaps.native_observed: COUNT and COUNT DISTINCT are known safe ungrouped aggregates with explicit aliases; their result is a scalar aggregate cell.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: a table projection; a scalar aggregate cell has no distinct representation and the existing aggregates declaration only supports returned-row SUM.
gaps.consequence: A valid count or distinct count cannot be safely represented as a record table; treating the cell as a normal row would lose the aggregate/alias distinction.

gaps.native_observed: SUM is not in the known safe ungrouped set; grouped aggregates need separate contract proof.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: host_verified_aggregates only for an explicit returned-row SUM declaration with matching column and unit.
gaps.consequence: Arithmetic ground truth in this fixture must not become a product-verified total. Grouped sums and totals must remain unverified until a separate contract proof exists.

gaps.native_observed: A positional row must have exactly one cell per column; ragged rows are malformed.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: row objects may omit a column key; missing keys become null because scalar(None) is accepted.
gaps.consequence: If object rows were produced by a lossy conversion, a missing cell could become a fabricated null instead of a rejected reply.

gaps.native_observed: returned count comes from data length; total, page and page size are separate fields.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: result_fact_metadata copies row_count, page and page_size when present; it does not read rows or total.
gaps.consequence: Native row_count and page_size become unknown, and total cannot be carried with a basis.

gaps.native_observed: valid zero, empty page, empty result, absent total, denied, failed and malformed are distinct.
gaps.current_adapter_expects: None projection for failures and malformed data; the caller must not turn that into zero or empty.
gaps.consequence: The adapter cannot itself publish the distinction; a native normalizer must preserve an explicit outcome class rather than returning only a missing card.

minimal_follow_up_after_HW_026: Add a bounded native-envelope normalizer that accepts only the observed dataset/columns/data/rows/page/has_more/optional total shape and maps it to business-result/v1 without changing authorization or approval behavior.

Map columns[].name to the result column key, preserve labels and types, and build object rows only by strict positional zip. Reject ragged rows, duplicate names, missing names/labels/types, non-scalar cells and non-finite numbers.
Compute returned_rows from len(data), never from rows. Preserve page, page_size and has_more as separate fields.

Preserve total with an explicit total_basis (records or groups) and provenance. If the basis is undeclared, expose it as ambiguous or unknown; never reinterpret a grouped total as records and never use total as an aggregate cell.
Represent ungrouped COUNT and COUNT DISTINCT as an explicitly labelled aggregate result with the alias; keep the existing safe scope language and do not claim independent truth or full scope.
Do not host-verify SUM, grouped SUM, grouped COUNT or grouped pagination completeness. Keep host_verified_aggregates limited to the existing explicit returned-row SUM declaration contract.
Carry an outcome class that separates valid zero, empty page, empty result, absent total, failure, denial, not-queried and malformed. A malformed reply must fail closed, not become zero or empty.
Update result_fact_metadata to use returned_rows, page, page_size and total_basis from the normalized result; do not invent row_count.
Re-run this fixture and update the current-adapter characterization test after HW-026. The fixture proves arithmetic and shape consistency only, not customer support or production acceptance.
